Commentary.Commentary: Time for celebrations! Sarfraz Ahmed has been handed the trophy and he is all smiles. The entire Pakistani side is posing for a photograph. That brings us to the close of a one-sided series. Pakistan are going from strength to strength. Everything is working well for them and they will be pleased that they have a wide range of players to choose from. On the other hand, the woes for the Sri Lankans continue. Three whitewashes in the same year in ODIs doesn't really augur well for them. The T20I series is coming up shortly. One more opportunity for the visitors to get their act together. Join us for the first game on 26th October in Abu Dhabi at 2000 local (1600 GMT). Meanwhile, you can keep a tab on the ongoing 1st Test between Zimbabwe and West Indies in Bulawayo where the tourists are in a very strong position. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed starts by thanking the Almighty and is really happy that they achieved a whitewash. Is short of words to laud the spell of Usman Khan and opines that he finished the match in the first 10 overs. Adds they have a lot of options now and everyone is contributing as and when the opportunity is given. He is pleased with their bowling but informs that he would be a bit more happy if their batting improves. Refuses to take all the credit for the success and mentions about the contribution of the team management, selectors and his boys. Ends by thanking the crowd for its support.

Sri Lanka skipper, Upul Tharanga says that the team is not playing to its strength. Adds that he is very disappointed. Further mentions that they didn't go past the 200-run mark on several occasions. States that the Pakistani bowlers' key to success is that they always strive for wickets. Rues the fact that the Lankans have suffered three whitewashes this year and will be aiming to improve in all departments.

Man of the Series, Hasan Ali thanks the Almighty and appreciates the support from the crowd as well. Adds he sticks to the basics and it is working nicely at the moment for him. Further says the conditions here in the UAE are tough but he keeps complete focus on how to get wickets. Informs the bouncer is the main weapon in his armory as he always wants to put the batsmen on the back foot.

Man of the Match, Usman Khan says that he is thankful to the Almighty. Adds that he is pleased with his performance and credits the bowling coach for it. Mentions that he is happy to have made this opportunity count. States that his dad forced him to play cricket and now when he looks back, he feels proud of his journey. He wants to dedicate this award to his parents. Informs that he focused on swinging the ball today and it worked out for him.

Ideally, Pakistan would have liked to win this by 10 wickets but the openers could not quite take the team past the finishing line. One of them stayed not out while the other got out, neither of them getting a half century. Sri Lanka were better with the ball, than with the bat. Nothing much can be described when they have bowled only slightly more than a T20I inning. In fact, the whole match has not even lasted a proper inning of an ODI. No doubts about the Man Of The Match but the real question is who gets the Series Award. If we were given the glory of being the jury, we would give it to Hasan Ali. Stay tuned for the presentation to find out who eventually gets it...

Pakistan will take this as a statement of intent to the world. An incompetent Sri Lanka may not be the best example but it definitely makes the world notice that their win over India in the Champions Trophy final was not a fluke. They have followed that with 5 more in a row. It is also their 9th successive win in ODIs and 11 out of their last 12.

Usually teams save their best for the last. Sri Lanka saved their worst for this final one. Cannot blame the batsmen entirely for not being able to play out Usman with his swing and movement. But this was not a 103 all out pitch, which came mostly due to some slogging from Thisara and Prasanna. His 5/34 today is his best not only in one-day cricket but in List A cricket as well. Terrific effort.

Pakistan have done it. A whitewash. Their 6th in a 5-match bilateral ODI series. Their first since 2008. This win with 178 balls remaining is their fifth biggest in ODI history. To cut things short, it was Pakistan's day. It has been Pakistan's series.

FOUR! Imam seals it for Pakistan in a convincing manner! Fraction short outside off, Imam rocks back and cuts it past short third man for a boundary. What a performance it has been from the home side throughout the series! Smiles all around in their camp. 9th win in a row in ODIs for the hosts while 12th defeat for Sri Lanka on the trot. PAKISTAN WIN BY 9 WICKETS WITH 178 BALLS TO SPARE!
Tossed up delivery, pushed to mid on for a run. Pakistan inching closer to a victory.
Tossed up outside off, Fahim goes for an agricultural slog across the line but gets it off the inner half to deep mid-wicket. A run taken.
Pushed quicker through the air, Ashraf hangs back and blocks it.
Googly on off, Imam shuffles across and works it to square leg for a run.
The wrong one outside off, Fahim eases it to covers for a run.
Quicker one outside off, Ashraf looks to dab it away but gets beaten.
Clipped with the spin to deep square leg for a run.

Well. We should have had a break at this time but because the runs required are few, common sense has prevailed to extend the game for a while, one guess by at least 30 minutes to see if Pakistan can finish this off.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on for a run.
Strides forward to this one and blocks it.
Ashraf swings hard at it but ends up hitting it off the inner half to long on for a run.
Outside off, cut to point for a single.
FOUR! Deft! Short delivery outside off, Imam cuts it late and gets it past short third man to find the fence.
Tossed up delivery, eased to covers.

No. Easily in. Imam plays this one to mid-wicket and sets off. The fielder returns the ball to the keeper who whips the bails off as Ashraf rushes in to make his ground. It is referred upstairs. The replays shows that the batsman is well in.
Run out appeal now! Will this be wicket number 2?
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Around off, Ashraf pushes at it but gets it off the inner half to square leg for a run.
Wide! Down the leg side, Ashraf tries to help it away but misses.
Uses his feet and milks it down to long on for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Short outside off, Fahim looks to cut it but misses.
Tossed up delivery, eased back to the bowler.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.
Fahim Ashraf comes out to bat. He has been promoted up the order to get some batting practice.

OUT! Sri Lanka get a wicket. Something to cheer. The decision is overturned. Fraction short outside off, Zaman looks to dab it to third man but misses. Dickwella grabs it and claims the catch. However, the umpire stays put. The bowler is confident and coaxes his captain to go for the review. Time for the replays. The Snicko spots the edge and Zaman has to walk back. He misses out on his fifty by 2 runs.
Is that out? No reaction from the batsman or the umpire. Sri Lanka decide to take a review against a caught behind decision against Zaman. Will they be able to avoid a 10-wicket defeat?
Zaman looks to slog this one across but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Imam wants a run but is sent back.
Imam uses his feet to the tossed up delivery and blocks it.
Fraction short on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Slow through the air, Zaman is early into his flick and hence, gets a soft leading edge to covers. A single taken.
Full toss on the pads, swept away to fine leg for a run.
Waits for this one to spin in and helps it to square leg.
Three Wides! Down the leg side, Imam goes for the sweep but misses. Dickwella also gets beaten and the ball rolls towards fine leg. Two runs taken.
On middle and leg, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and blocks it.
Imam tucks this one to square leg for a run.
Outside off, stroked to sweeper cover for a run.
Brilliant fielding! Imam drives it crisply to the left side of Vandersay who runs towards it, dives full length and denies a run to the batsmen.
Tapped back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Turns this one with the spin to square leg.
Spinning in sharply from outside off, Imam shuffles across and looks to defend but is hit on the front pad. The impact was outside the line, hence no appeal.
Leans ahead and drives it to long on for a single.
Short on middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish delivery, Zaman goes for the sweep but gets a bottom edge to fine leg. A couple taken.
Floated delivery, eased back to the bowler.
Clipped to backward square leg for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Seekkuge Prasanna to roll his arm over now.
Helps this one with the spin to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, tapped back to the bowler.
Places this one to the point region for a run.
FOUR! Hammered! Full delivery on off, Zaman clears his front leg and drills it through extra cover for a rocketing boundary.
Outside off, eased to covers for a quick run.
Drifting towards the pads, helped to short fine leg.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short delivery on leg stump, Zaman stands tall and pulls it over backward square leg to find the fence. He hit that with a lot of power and got the desired result.
Back of a length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot to extra cover.
Short of a length ball on middle, Imam swivels across and pulls it hard to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Waits for this one and plays it with soft hands to third man for a run.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Fullish delivery on the pads, swinging down. Zaman whips it past short fine leg and the ball races to the fence.
Around the pads, Imam helps it to the man at short fine leg.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Zaman strokes it to mid on to rotate strike.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. They pick up a single.
Floated outside off, stroked to covers.
Turns this one away with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Full delivery on off, jammed back to the bowler.

Time for Powerplay 2! Maximum of four fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. If the match goes till then, which seems highly highly highly unlikely. Might as well keep all 9 fielders in the ring.
Bouncer around off, Imam sways away from the line to evade it.
SIX! What a hit! Such confidence and composure when he played that. Imam comes down to the length delivery on off and lifts it over long on for a biggie. Clean as a whistle.
Full length ball on off, Imam-ul-Haq puts his head down and eases it to short mid-wicket.
Length delivery slanting across Fakhar who plays it with an angled blade to third man for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Good length delivery on off, generates some extra bounce from the surface. Imam is surprised by it and ends up gloving it to backward point. A sharp run taken.
Thisara Perera is brought in for a bowl.
Slow through the air on off, Zaman prods forward to defend but gets it off the outer half to point.
This time it is the conventional leg spinner around off, Fakhar goes for the cut but misses. Dickwella also fails to collect it. That was too close to cut.
FOUR! This time he finds the gap. Similar delivery, Zaman makes good use of the depth of the crease and cuts it past the right side of the backward point fielder to pick up a boundary.
The wrong one around off, Zaman rocks back and cuts it but finds the man at backward point.
Floated on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Tossed up on middle and leg, eased past the left side of the bowler for a run.
Time for spin. Jeffrey Vandersay comes into the attack.
FOUR! Beautiful! Full length ball outside off, Zaman leans into it and caresses it through covers to find the fence.
Fine leg in place now.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Imam half-pulls it towards short mid-wicket where Thirimanne jogs towards it and lets it go through. School boy error from him. A run conceded.
Short delivery outside off, Imam drops his wrists to let it be.
Rush of blood for Imam! Fullish delivery outside off, Imam goes for a slog down the ground but misses it completely. His head position was nowhere as he attempted the shot.
Shaping into Zaman from outside off who clips it through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Length delivery outside off, Zaman shows minimal foot movement and punches it to covers
Similar length delivery around off, Zaman goes for the heave but drags it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Short of a length delivery, tucked through square leg for a couple.
Short delivery, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.

Angling into Fakhar who tucks it to mid-wicket and calls for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. It would have been close if he hit. The dive from Fakhar might have saved him though.
Stays back to the good length delivery and blocks it.
FOUR! Sublime! Fullish delivery on off, Imam-ul-Haq shuffles a bit and times his drive to perfection past mid on. Timing and grace written all over it and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Fuller length delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.

Zaman drives this one to Fernando who deflects it from his right hand towards wide mid off. Zaman takes off for a run but his partner is ball-watching. He waits and as it goes past the mid off fielder, the batsmen finally decide to take the run.
Full ball outside off, jammed out to cover-point.
FOUR! Well played! Very full well outside off, Zaman creams it past the diving extra cover fielder and once it went past him, the result was destined.
Good length delivery well outside off, skidding through the surface. Zaman plays away from the body and hence, gets beaten.
Angling in towards the hips, tucked to the leg side.
Fuller length ball on off, eased beside the pitch on the off side. Imam wants a run but is rightly sent back.
Shortish delivery on the body, Imam rises with the bounce to keep it out. The ball hits the high part of the willow and rolls to square leg.
Leg bye! Zaman is beaten for pace again as he misses his flick and the ball rolls off his pads to square leg. A run taken.
On a length, going down with the angle. Zaman looks to whip it away but is hit on the pads. Stifled appeal for an LBW is turned down. That was clearly going down leg.
Fractionally overpitched on off, driven crisply to extra cover.
Back of a length and width on offer, Imam-ul-Haq slaps it to backward point.
Full length delivery at 141 clicks on off stump, Imam strides forward and blocks it stoutly.
Angling down the leg side, Imam tickles it off his pads to fine leg. A couple taken.
FOUR! That shot will give him confidence! On a length well outside off, Imam shimmies down the track and lifts it over the cover region for a majestic boundary.
Well bowled! Hurls this on a length in the off stump channel and gets it to angle in appreciably. Imam looks to counter it by staying back but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Short and room on offer, Imam slaps it straight to the man at point.
Shuffles across to the fullish delivery and works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
On a drivable length outside off, Imam goes at it with hard hands but mistimes it towards extra cover.
Angling into Imam who tucks it to mid-wicket.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Leg bye! Slanting down the leg side, Fakhar tries to play it across but is hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards backward square leg. A single taken.
Fullish delivery on off, driven sweetly to mid off.
That's a peach! Good length delivery around off, straightens after pitching. Imam has no option but to play at it and is beaten comprehensively. End of a testing maiden over from Fernando.
Imam is looking fidgety in the middle. Feels for a delivery outside off again and misses it completely.
Play and a miss! In the corridor of uncertainty, seaming away after pitching. Imam has a poke at it and misses.
Fullish delivery, some wobble in the air. Imam plants his front foot across and eases it to point.
On a length well outside off, this time Imam-ul-Haq doesn't flirt with it.
Loose shot! Full length delivery outside off, swinging away. Imam goes fishing after it but gets beaten. Pakistan need to be careful, can't afford to take things lightly.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. A slip and gully in place.
Short and width on offer, Zaman cuts it hard to the man at point.
Chameera goes around the wicket and bowls a length ball on off, Zaman pushes it off the back foot to mid on.
FOUR! Crashed! Fuller length delivery and a bit of room on offer. Zaman extends his arms and slaps it through cover-point for a rocketing boundary.
Good length delivery angling away from Zaman who punches it nicely through covers for a brace.
Pakistan are away! Fullish and straying on the pads, helped around the corner for a run.
Full length ball on off, Imam drives it past the bowler and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end.
We are back for the chase. Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq to open the batting for Pakistan. Dushmantha Chameera runs in with the first new ball. A slip and gully in place. Here we go....
